definitions.gloss: water-soluble; the property of dissolving in water
definitions.explanation: Describes substances or materials that dissolve in water. Commonly used in health, food science, and chemistry contexts.

examples.japanese: {水溶性|すいようせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ビタミン→ビタミン：09770_bitamin⟧。
{水溶性|すいようせい}⟦{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}→食物繊維：15118_shokumotsuseni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{腸内環境|ちょうないかんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧。
examples.english: Water-soluble dietary fiber helps regulate the intestinal environment.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビタミン→ビタミン：09770_bitamin⟧C⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水溶性|すいようせい}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{加熱|かねつ}する→加熱する：19637_kanetsusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{失|うしな}われ→失う：01887_ushinau⟧やすい。
examples.english: Since vitamin C is water-soluble, it is easily lost through heating.

notes:
Composed of {水|すい} (water) + {溶|よう} (dissolve) + ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (property, nature). A technical term frequently encountered in nutrition labels, health articles, and science contexts. The opposite is {脂溶性|しようせい} (fat-soluble).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水溶性|すいようせい}⟦ビタミン→ビタミン：09770_bitamin⟧: water-soluble vitamin (B group, C)
- {水溶性|すいようせい}⟦{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}→食物繊維：15118_shokumotsuseni⟧: water-soluble dietary fiber
- {水溶性|すいようせい}⟦{塗料|とりょう}→塗料：24548_toryou⟧: water-soluble paint
- {水溶性|すいようせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧: water-soluble components

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {脂溶性|しようせい}: fat-soluble — the direct counterpart; vitamins A, D, E, K are fat-soluble
- {水溶液|すいようえき}: aqueous solution — the solution itself, not the property
